t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Eu sun testie, o meis Dieu, cha Tü m'hast crè per At cugnuoscher e per T'adorar. Eu attest en quist moment mia dèblezza e Tia pussanza, mia paupradat e Tia rihezia. I u da ing üter Dieu arsalv Tai, Tü chi güdast in privel, Tü chi consisist en Tai svessa.
